summary: Feed s138_double is degraded: NDR port overloaded by 1ms microbursts to 13.49 Gbps (135% of 10 Gbps) and encrypted share at 94.2% exceeds 90% tolerance, reducing detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: Microbursts peaking at 13.49 Gbps exceed the single 10 Gbps NDR port capacity (135% utilization) in 2 intervals. Packet broker is aggregating traffic to one tool port without load balancing or burst buffering.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR will drop packets at ingress during bursts, causing incomplete flows, missed detections, and degraded stateful analysis and forensics.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across 2+ NDR ports/instances with flow-aware hashing to keep per-port utilization below 80% and absorb 1ms bursts without drops.

findings.root_cause: 94.2% of bytes are encrypted (TLS), above the NDR's 90% tolerance. Traffic is opaque to payload inspection without broker-assisted decryption.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload for deep inspection; at 94% encrypted, payload-based detection is blind and limited to metadata/flow analysis only.

recommended_fix.why: Decrypt selectively at the packet broker or export enriched metadata (SNI, JA3, decrypted flow) to restore NDR visibility while respecting privacy policy.
